name: release-management-enablement-gap-reporter
description: Meta adoption view of which repos and teams have adopted readiness reviews, release testing, and the CI/CD integration together, and where the enablement gaps are, so the rollout can be driven to completion. Read-only. Recommends AWS MCP augmentation (AWS Documentation MCP Server for enablement steps and a custom source-control MCP) used alongside the connected associations and AWS reads.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 08:00 UTC
